svg.text: Four-tool benchmark: known-truth accuracy and real-world disagreement
Synthetic raw accuracy is separated from 1% thresholded reporting behavior; real PCAWG results quantify tool-to-tool divergence without truth labels.
Mean cosine to published true fractions; no post-fit cutoff
Mean F1 after common 1% cutoff; truth activity > 0
Mean L1 distance between relative-exposure vectors
Mean Jaccard after the common 1% cutoff
Mean across-tool range in relative exposure across 38 samples
Heatmap abbreviations: SPA, SigProfilerAssignment. Synthetic panels test accuracy; PCAWG panels test triangulation and do not establish biological truth.
All tools use complete-catalog relative fractions; accuracy is evaluated before filtering, and active calls use a common 1% cutoff followed by renormalization.
